verdict.rationale: Datalab's single /convert endpoint takes "a PDF, image, or document". Its docs name PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets and images, and the Marker engine behind the API is documented on GitHub as converting PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML and EPUB as well. That covers most of the mix through one call, but email formats are never mentioned, and PPTX/HTML support is shown only for the open-source library, not the hosted API docs. Missing for 10: email (EML/MSG) support, explicit API-level documentation of PPTX and HTML input, an enumerated supported-formats list for the API, and hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.

support.subject: As a developer, one API handles my whole document mix — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email — without per-format plumbing
